name: SikaColor Flo
paste:
SIKACOLOR® FLO: SPECIFICATION CLAUSE SET

Source: SikaColor® Flo, April 2023, Version 01.02 (https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/w/sikacolor_flo.pdf)
Draft for specifier review. Wording, values and standards are quoted from that data sheet; where it is silent the clause says 'Refer to manufacturer.' Confirm the current edition before issue.

1 SCOPE
1.1 Work included. Provide SikaColor® Flo where documented, installed or applied in accordance with this clause and the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (April 2023, Version 01.02).
1.2 Product description. SikaColor® Flo Liquid Colors are pre dispersed metal oxide pigments containing high pigment solids in an aqueous base liquid.
1.3 Intended uses stated by the manufacturer. The use of colours and the ColorSelect® PC Liquid dispensing System provides an easy handling, dust free environment for integral colouring of:
    - Concrete Blocks & Pavers
    - Concrete Floors
    - Vertical Precast
    - Poured in Place Concrete
1.4 Limits of use. Observe the manufacturer's limitations stated in clause 4.5.

2 MATERIALS
2.1 Product. SikaColor® Flo
    - Product type as printed on the data sheet: Liquid concrete colours
    - Supplier as printed on the data sheet: Sika Australia Pty Limited, ABN 12 001 342 329, aus.sika.com, Tel: 1300 22 33 48
2.2 Approvals, certificates and standards stated by the manufacturer. Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (April 2023, Version 01.02) has no approvals, certificates or standards section.
2.3 Characteristics stated by the manufacturer. SikaColor® Flo Liquid Colour is a water based liquid colour containing proprietary chemicals for dispersion and suspension of the metal oxide pigments. All Colour products are thixotropic in nature, which means they remain thick when standing for an extended period.
2.4 Composition, appearance and supply.
    - Composition: Inorganic Metal Oxide in aqueous solution.
    - Appearance and colour: Liquid (in different colours)
2.5 Packaging, shelf life and storage.
    - Packaging: Returnable ColorSelect® Totes
    - Shelf life: 12 months from date of production if stored properly in original, unopened packaging, at temperatures between +5°C and +35°C.
2.6 Storage conditions. Store at temperatures between +5°C and +35°C. Protect SikaColor® Flo from direct sunlight and freezing. Frost: If frozen and/or if precipitation has occurred, SikaColor® Flo may be used after thawing slowly at room temperature and intensive mixing.

3 SUBSTRATE PREPARATION
3.1 Substrate preparation. Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (April 2023, Version 01.02) states no substrate preparation requirements.

4 APPLICATION
4.1 General. Apply in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (April 2023, Version 01.02) and the requirements below.
4.2 Recommended dosage. Product is available in numerous standard colours as indicated in the Colour Card using 1 % to 8 % loadings by weight of cement. Dosing up to 10 % liquid colours are possible but do not improve the colour saturation normally. Different shades of Portland Cement, Cement replacement, aggregates, consistency and finishing techniques create differences in the final concrete colour.
4.3 Compatibility. SikaColor® Flo may be combined with many other Sika Concrete Admixtures. Important: Always conduct trials before combining products in specific mixes and contact our Technical Service Department for information and advice about any specific combinations.
4.4 Dispensing.
    - SikaColor® Flo should be agitated prior to use to insure uniformity.
    - For a zero-slump application, SikaColor® Flo is added just after the pre-wetted aggregate and before the cement addition. This allows the aggregate to distribute the colour uniformly, which will promote an even distribution of pigment particles on the surface of the cement crystals.
    - For ready mix applications, SikaColor® Flo may be added in front, during the batching or at the end of the batch cycle.
4.5 Limitations and important considerations.
    - The standard rules of good concreting practice, concerning production and placing, shall be followed.
    - Laboratory trials shall be carried out before concreting on site, especially when using a new (changed) mix design or producing new concrete components.
    - Fresh concrete must be cured properly and curing applied as early as possible.
    - Sika strongly recommends pouring a mock-up for approval prior to starting the job.

5 QUALITY CONTROL AND TESTING
5.1 Hold point. Before each application, confirm the site conditions with the manufacturer. HOLD POINT: do not proceed until the Superintendent has released the hold point.
5.2 Conditions to be verified. Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (April 2023, Version 01.02) lists no application condition limits.
5.3 Trials, test areas and compatibility checks stated by the manufacturer.
    - Sika strongly recommends pouring a mock-up for approval prior to starting the job.
5.4 Basis of the stated values. All technical data stated in this Product Data Sheet are based on laboratory tests. Actual measured data may vary due to circumstances beyond our control.
5.5 Other tests. For any test method, sampling frequency or acceptance criterion not stated in this clause: refer to manufacturer and the project specification.

6 WARRANTY AND DOCUMENTATION
6.1 Documents to be obtained and submitted. Obtain the current issue of each document before ordering and submit it with the product submission. Documents are listed as published on the manufacturer's website.
    - Product Data Sheet: SikaColor® Flo, April 2023, Version 01.02, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/w/sikacolor_flo.pdf
    - Safety Data Sheet: Sika® ColorFlo®- CF115 / CF413 / CF417, version 22/07/2024, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/o/Sika%20ColorFlo%20CF115.CF413.CF417.pdf
    - Safety Data Sheet: SDS Sika® ColorFlo®, version 18/06/2025, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/p/sds-sika-colorflo.pdf
    - Safety Data Sheet: SDS Sika® ColorFlo®, version 18/06/2025, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/d/sds-sika-colorflo.pdf
    - Safety Data Sheet: SDS Sika® ColorFlo®, version 26/06/2025, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/c/sds-sika-colorflo.pdf
6.2 Ecology, health and safety. For information and advice on the safe handling, storage and disposal of chemical products, users shall refer to the most recent Material Safety Data Sheet containing physical, ecological, toxicological and other safety-related data.
6.3 Warranty. Obtain any product or installation warranty in writing from the manufacturer or its authorised applicator and file it with the project records. Warranty terms: refer to manufacturer.
    - Legal notes: In practice, the differences in materials, substrates and actual site conditions are such that no warranty in respect of merchantability or of fitness for a particular purpose, nor any liability arising out of any legal relationship whatsoever, can be inferred either from this information, or from any written recommendations, or from any other advice offered.
6.4 Local restrictions. Please note that as a result of specific local regulations the declared data for this product may vary from country to country. Please consult the local Product Data Sheet for the exact product data.
6.5 Application records. Record the product name, batch numbers, dates, areas treated and the conditions measured under clause 5.1, and include the records in the project documentation.
